question: What universal range of reality must be encompassed in this meditation at every locus?
premises: Meditation is to be done in place after place
The object of meditation extends from Śiva to Avīci
The scope covers the full range of reality
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality extending from Śiva down to Avīci
